CustomField.description: Lookup to Account with an FQS-added lookup filter restricting selection to IsPersonAccount = True. When set, HonoreeName should mirror the Person Account's full name; FQS does not auto-sync.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Person Account the tribute is for. Use this when the honoree already exists in FundFirst as a Person Account; fall back to Honoree Name for one-off honorees who don't need their own record.

lookupFilter.errorMessage: Select an individual (person account) for the honoree contact.
